info.description:
Hedra API v3 provides managed multimodal inference with a shared prepaid API wallet. Use the [vision and reasoning quickstart](https://www.hedra.com/docs/pages/developer/v3/quickstart) for supported image-understanding and language models through POST /v3/chat/completions. The language API also exposes POST /v3/responses and POST /v3/anthropic/v1/messages compatibility routes.

Image, video, and audio generation use asynchronous jobs: submit to POST /v3/models/{model}, then follow status and retrieve outputs. See the [model-job quickstart](https://www.hedra.com/docs/pages/developer/v3/model-jobs). Each model defines its supported inputs and outputs; inspect GET /v3/models/{model} before integrating.

Create an [API key](https://www.hedra.com/develop/api-keys) and fund the [API wallet](https://www.hedra.com/develop/billing). Studio subscription credits are separate. Direct requests accept Key or Bearer authentication; language-model requests require chat:write. See [authentication](https://www.hedra.com/docs/pages/developer/v3/authentication).

For asynchronous jobs, estimate cost with POST /v3/models/{model}/estimate and use polling, server-sent events, or signed webhooks to follow completion. For chat requests, read the completion response or stream it; do not apply the model-job polling loop.

For World Model Runtime, model adaptation, and custom deployment access, see [Platform and availability](https://www.hedra.com/docs/pages/developer/v3/platform).

post.description: Run Hedra Avatar through the v3 API to generate audio-driven avatar video. Inspect the image and audio inputs, limits, and job output.
Run Hedra Character 3 through the v3 API to generate audio-driven character video. Inspect the required image and audio inputs.

get.description: List inference jobs on Hedra and inspect their status, model, and outputs. Use the available filters and pagination to find a request.
Retrieve a Hedra inference job by ID. Inspect its status, outputs, errors, usage, and cost using the v3 API.
Check the status of a Hedra inference job, including progress and estimated completion time when available.
Read the lifecycle logs for a Hedra inference job. Inspect job events and errors to troubleshoot a request.
Stream status updates for a Hedra inference job with server-sent events. Follow progress through completion or failure.
List models available through the Hedra v3 API. Compare modalities and model IDs before inspecting a model-specific inference contract.
Inspect a Hedra model by ID. Read its input and output schemas, supported capabilities, limits, and pricing before integrating.
List inference jobs for a specific Hedra model. Inspect job history and use the available pagination controls.

post.description: Estimate the price of a Hedra image, video, or audio request using its model-specific inputs, without submitting an inference job.
Create a scoped API key for the Hedra v3 API. Review the credential response and use the key to authenticate your integration.

get.description: List Hedra API keys for a workspace. Inspect key metadata and scopes to manage credentials used by your v3 integrations.

post.description: Rotate a Hedra API key by ID. Review the rotation request and credential response before updating your integration.

delete.description: Revoke a Hedra API key by ID to stop it authenticating v3 API requests. Review the required parameters and response.

post.description: Create a scoped, short-lived Hedra token for client access. Review the token request, workspace, and expiration fields.

get.description: Read the prepaid USD API wallet balance for your Hedra workspace. Check available funds before making billable inference requests.
Inspect Hedra v3 API usage over a time range. Use the supported grouping options to review inference consumption.
Retrieve Hedra's Ed25519 public key to verify signed webhook deliveries. Use it with the signature verification steps in the webhook guide.
Read the default Hedra webhook configuration used for inference jobs that do not specify a per-job webhook URL.

put.description: Set or update the default Hedra webhook endpoint for job results. Configure the destination URL and whether deliveries are enabled.

delete.description: Remove the default Hedra webhook configuration. Jobs can still specify a per-job webhook URL when submitted.

post.description: Send a test delivery to your default Hedra webhook endpoint. Inspect the response to check the connection before relying on job events.

get.description: List Hedra webhook deliveries and inspect their status, attempts, and outcomes. Use the results to investigate delivery failures.
List log drains configured for your Hedra workspace. Inspect destinations, delivery health, and enabled status.

post.description: Create a Hedra log drain to send job lifecycle events to your HTTPS endpoint in NDJSON or OTLP format.

get.description: Read a Hedra log drain by ID. Inspect its configuration, enabled status, and recent delivery health.

patch.description: Update a Hedra log drain by ID. Change its destination, format, credentials, or enabled status using the published request fields.

delete.description: Delete a Hedra log drain by ID to stop sending job lifecycle events to its destination.

post.description: Send a test batch to a Hedra log drain destination. Inspect the response to verify your log receiver configuration.
Run ElevenLabs English STS V2 through the Hedra v3 API. Submit a speech-to-speech inference job and retrieve its audio output.
Run ElevenLabs Multilingual STS V2 through the Hedra v3 API. Inspect its speech-to-speech inputs, submit a job, and retrieve audio.
Run Kling 1.6 through the Hedra v3 API. Inspect its video-generation inputs, submit an asynchronous job, and retrieve the result.
Generate video with MiniMax Hailuo 02 through the Hedra v3 API. Inspect supported inputs and quality levels before submitting a job.
Generate video with MiniMax Hailuo 2.3 through the Hedra v3 API. Inspect supported inputs and quality levels before submitting a job.
